summary: Made the phase-to-owner registry explicitly keyed by P0-P7 and hoisted required-input policy out of the resolver hot path.

Removed the stale state parameter from success sealing, validated the shared source timestamp once per registration batch, and reused invalidation suffix/remaining-phase/redacted-reason values without changing phase, gate, retry, identity, containment, loader, or serialization behavior.
README serialization required no behavior-preserving simplification; the existing bounded projection remains unchanged.
The journal entry was pre-existing orchestration state and was not modified by this refactor.
